My primary symptom: Severe lower abdominal pain and dyspnea after catheter drainage failure.

When you say “catheter drainage failure,” what kind of catheter is it (urinary Foley/suprapubic, nephrostomy, peritoneal drain, dialysis catheter, etc.), and what was it placed for?

Also: when did the severe lower abdominal pain and shortness of breath start (sudden vs gradual), and do you have any fever/chills or inability to pass urine/gas?

message.content: It is a pouch catheter that was placed because I have been having a lot of trouble catheterizing my MAINZ pouch on my own for the last few weeks. The pain and shortness of breath started after the catheter stopped draining properly last night. I am not sure if it was sudden or gradual, and I do not know about fevers or chills. I have definitely noticed that my urine output has been very low since the drainage failed.
